doc_metadata.notes: Appendix C1 specifies minimum qualification requirements for learning and development programs and assessments. Document establishes supplier eligibility gates for organizational experience and resource capacity.
doc_metadata.title: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, learning and organizational development services

evaluation_criteria.notes: Two mandatory qualification gates establish supplier eligibility. Both must be satisfied for proponent to proceed. Evaluation mechanism is binary Yes/No confirmation.

source_refs.excerpt: # | Minimum qualification requirements | Proponent Response Yes / No

evaluation_criteria.threshold: Pass/Fail (Yes/No confirmation required for both M1 and M2)
evaluation_criteria.title: Minimum Qualification Gate

requirements.description: Proponent must confirm that it is an established firm and has delivered at least three (3) organization-wide learning and development engagements of similar scope and complexity within the last five (5) years for organizations with a minimum of 1,000 employees.
requirements.evidence: Proponent Response (Yes/No confirmation); supporting case studies or engagement documentation demonstrating three prior engagements meeting scope, complexity, and client size criteria

source_refs.excerpt: Organizational Experience (Minimum Five (5) Years) Proponent must confirm that it is an established firm and has delivered at least three (3) organization-wide learning and development engagements of similar scope and complexity within the last five (5) years for organizations with a minimum of 1,000 employees.
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix C1 - Minimum qualification requirements.xlsx

requirements.description: Proponent must confirm they have a minimum of five (5) qualified learning and development professionals available to deliver services under the agreement, including at least one senior curriculum designer and one senior facilitator.
requirements.evidence: Proponent Response (Yes/No confirmation); organizational chart, resumes, or staffing plan demonstrating availability of five qualified professionals with specified senior roles

source_refs.excerpt: Dedicated Resource Capacity Proponent must confirm they have a minimum of five (5) qualified learning and development professionals available to deliver services under the agreement, including at least one senior curriculum designer and one senior facilitator.
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix C1 - Minimum qualification requirements.xlsx

submission_rules.details: Proponent must respond Yes or No to each of the two minimum qualification requirements (Organizational Experience and Dedicated Resource Capacity). Supporting evidence (case studies, resumes, staffing documentation) is implied but format and submission channel are not specified in this excerpt.
submission_rules.format: Yes/No confirmation format as structured in Appendix C1
